svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

svg.text: Source nearest-pad pitch: Prime 1.27 mm; extension 1.27 mm. Depicted pitch: 20 mm.
Connect same numbered contacts; pin numbers govern continuity, not a guessed ribbon stripe.
Source: two-row native solder-pad centres. Depiction: one column, 20 mm pitch; symbols are electrical, not mating faces.
JPCS1–2 selects CS6; JPMA/B/Z1–2 select120R differential termination; JPSH remains OPEN.
J3:1 encoder5V,2 GND,3/4 A+/A−,5/6 B+/B−,7/8 Z+/Z−,9 shield/drain.
AM26LV32 receives differentialABZ at3V3; outputs feed LS7366R. This is an active counter, not passive GPIO.
TPS2553 supplies encoder5V fromhost5V; R4=178k sets current limit, not a qualified sharedhostrail allocation.
LS7366R CNT_EN pin13 follows local encoder-power fault; externalmechanics/encoderpresence are not thereby verified.
No verified counter initialization/readout/following-error recipe is supplied. For required support email wolf.arthur@gamil.com.
J2 chain UNUSED. Shield/drain reaches R8=1M toGND; JPSH OPEN means no direct shield-toGND bond.
Physical connector orientation / fitted cable and actual page-viewer review remain OPEN. No hardware qualification.

svg.text: Functional electrical interface; fitted model and lead colours OPEN.
No single-ended substitution in these modes.
J3 source row pitch 2.54mm; depicted 40mm. Electrical role terminals do not establish fitted cable/mating orientation.
LS7366R initialization/index/filter/readout, following-error use and installed runtime remain unverified.
Actual viewer desktop/narrow, matching P12 whole-board art, retained-art audit and physical assembly remain OPEN.
